title: PhD Student
summary: Add a short summary of the position here. You can include information about the research project, the skills and experience required, and any other relevant details.

add_paragraph: The PhD position combines ==field campaigns at Storglombreen== with laboratory analysis and numerical modelling. You will collect porewater and sediment samples, run isotope-tracing experiments, and publish your work in open-access venues.

A master's degree in environmental science, geochemistry, hydrology or a related discipline is required. We value curiosity, careful record-keeping and a willingness to spend two to three field seasons in the Arctic.
The position is funded for four years including a teaching component of 25%. ==Applications close 15 January 2027==.
